prompt:
Task: verify the uploaded side-by-side video only. Do not select a clip. Do not use any previous chat context.

The video has two panels:
- Left panel A: edited clip r_ztjHaHmcg, clip time 1:32.555 to 2:01.147.
- Right panel B: source candidate -DwSCDMCWDQ, source time 40:04.730 to 40:33.322.

Decide whether A and B show the same original moment: same topic, same spoken content, same conversation flow. A may have added captions, zoom/crop, BGM, sound effects, or editor-added audio. Treat those as differences, not automatic rejection.

Return JSON only. No markdown. Use this exact shape:
{"chunkIndex":3,"status":"confirmed|uncertain|rejected","clipStartMs":92555,"clipEndMs":121147,"sourceStartMs":2404730,"sourceEndMs":2433322,"confidenceReason":"short reason","alignmentNotes":["what matches or does not match"],"visibleDifferences":["captions/crop/BGM/SE/editor additions if visible or audible"],"usableForExpectedCuts":false}

alignmentNotes: Both panels show the streamer discussing YouTube's revenue per view mechanics using hypothetical examples (100 views vs 1000 views). The cadence, jokes, and expressions are fully identical.
visibleDifferences: The left panel has large stylized text subtitles added at the bottom, an overlay of game footage on the virtual living room screen, and background music/cropping edits typical of a vertical short or compiled highlight clip.
